Hey! It would be nice if you could share a reproducing fiddle, so we can see if it's purely the number or the exact combination you use. Feel free to share it on support@algolia.com and mention this issue if you'd rather not share it publicly. Thanks!

A starter template is here: https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch-templates/tree/master/src/InstantSearch.js
